en-US.name: BobFWTools Studio
en-US.subtitle: Mobile Diagnostics & Firmware Utility
en-US.description:
BobFWTools Studio (Bobby's Workshop v5.0.0) is a fast, reliable native mobile hardware diagnostics, USB descriptor inspection, and firmware servicing utility.

• Native BootForge USB descriptor & interface inspection
• Supports 150+ iOS/iPadOS hardware profiles and 20+ Android OEM families
• USB Cable Doctor & link quality grading
• Encrypted local servicing history ledger & technician audit notes
• Universal 2 native performance on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs (macOS 12.0+)
